knowledge.statement: node.run() keeps a local proposal gate armed only as a side effect of observing a leader change: when r.lead changes and a leader exists it sets propc = n.propc, when no leader exists it sets propc = nil, and after applying a conf change that removes the local node from the configuration it sets propc = nil. knowledge.statement: node.Propose and node.ProposeConfChange hand a MsgProp to the run loop through stepWithWaitOption, which sends the request on the node's proposal channel n.propc (an unbuffered channel field that is always non-nil) and, when the call waits for a result, blocks until the run loop accepts the request or the caller's context or the node stop ends the wait.
